title: Administrative Procedure for a Subway Stair Relocation or Renovation
previewText: For any development or enlargement that is subject to the requirements for the relocation of a subway stair entrance or counts a renovated subway stair as pedestrian circulation space in accordance with the provisions of Section 37-50 (REQUIREMENTS FOR PEDESTRIAN CIRCULATION SPACE), inclusive, no plan shall be approved by the Department of Buildings and no excavation permit or building permit shall be issued, unless

blocks.html: For any development or enlargement that is subject to the requirements for the relocation of a subway stair entrance or counts a renovated subway stair as pedestrian circulation space in accordance with the provisions of Section 37-50 (REQUIREMENTS FOR PEDESTRIAN CIRCULATION SPACE), inclusive, no plan shall be approved by the Department of Buildings and no excavation permit or building permit shall be issued, unless the following criteria are met:
blocks.plainText: For any development or enlargement that is subject to the requirements for the relocation of a subway stair entrance or counts a renovated subway stair as pedestrian circulation space in accordance with the provisions of Section 37-50 (REQUIREMENTS FOR PEDESTRIAN CIRCULATION SPACE), inclusive, no plan shall be approved by the Department of Buildings and no excavation permit or building permit shall be issued, unless the following criteria are met:

blocks.html: (a)        for a relocated entrance, such plan includes a stair relocation plan and related documents that require:
blocks.plainText: (a) for a relocated entrance, such plan includes a stair relocation plan and related documents that require:

blocks.html: (1)        construction of the new stair entrance in accordance with such plan;
blocks.plainText: (1) construction of the new stair entrance in accordance with such plan;

blocks.html: (2)        demolition of above-ground elements of the existing entrance;
blocks.plainText: (2) demolition of above-ground elements of the existing entrance;

blocks.html: (3)        sealing of the existing entrance at the sidewalk level; and
blocks.plainText: (3) sealing of the existing entrance at the sidewalk level; and

blocks.html: (4)        maintenance of the work performed on the relocated or renovated entrance; or
blocks.plainText: (4) maintenance of the work performed on the relocated or renovated entrance; or

blocks.html: (b)        for a renovated entrance, such plan includes a renovation plan and related documents that require:
blocks.plainText: (b) for a renovated entrance, such plan includes a renovation plan and related documents that require:

blocks.html: (1)        renovation of the entrance in accordance with such plan; and
blocks.plainText: (1) renovation of the entrance in accordance with such plan; and

blocks.html: (2)        maintenance of the work performed on the renovated entrance; and
blocks.plainText: (2) maintenance of the work performed on the renovated entrance; and

blocks.html: (c)        such plan and related documents bear New York City Transit’s approval; and
blocks.plainText: (c) such plan and related documents bear New York City Transit’s approval; and

blocks.html: (d)        such plan is accompanied by a certified copy of an agreement, as recorded between New York City Transit and the owner for an easement on the zoning lot for subway-related use of the new stair entrance and for public access via such entrance to the subway station, which agreement has been recorded against the zoning lot in the Office of the Register of the City of New York and is accompanied by the Register's receipt of recordation; and
blocks.plainText: (d) such plan is accompanied by a certified copy of an agreement, as recorded between New York City Transit and the owner for an easement on the zoning lot for subway-related use of the new stair entrance and for public access via such entrance to the subway station, which agreement has been recorded against the zoning lot in the Office of the Register of the City of New York and is accompanied by the Register's receipt of recordation; and

blocks.html: (e)        no permanent certificate of occupancy shall be issued for the building either altered or developed, as set forth in Section 37-40, or enlarged, that is subject to the subway stair relocation requirement or is counting a renovated subway stair as pedestrian circulation space in accordance with the provisions of Section 37-50, inclusive, unless and until all of the work required under paragraph (a) or (b) of this Section has been completed and New York City Transit has so certified in writing to the Department of Buildings.
blocks.plainText: (e) no permanent certificate of occupancy shall be issued for the building either altered or developed, as set forth in Section 37-40, or enlarged, that is subject to the subway stair relocation requirement or is counting a renovated subway stair as pedestrian circulation space in accordance with the provisions of Section 37-50, inclusive, unless and until all of the work required under paragraph (a) or (b) of this Section has been completed and New York City Transit has so certified in writing to the Department of Buildings.

subsections.label: (a)
subsections.plainText: (a) for a relocated entrance, such plan includes a stair relocation plan and related documents that require:
(1) construction of the new stair entrance in accordance with such plan;
(2) demolition of above-ground elements of the existing entrance;
(3) sealing of the existing entrance at the sidewalk level; and
(4) maintenance of the work performed on the relocated or renovated entrance; or

subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) for a renovated entrance, such plan includes a renovation plan and related documents that require:
(1) renovation of the entrance in accordance with such plan; and
(2) maintenance of the work performed on the renovated entrance; and

subsections.label: (c)
subsections.plainText: (c) such plan and related documents bear New York City Transit’s approval; and

subsections.label: (d)
subsections.plainText: (d) such plan is accompanied by a certified copy of an agreement, as recorded between New York City Transit and the owner for an easement on the zoning lot for subway-related use of the new stair entrance and for public access via such entrance to the subway station, which agreement has been recorded against the zoning lot in the Office of the Register of the City of New York and is accompanied by the Register's receipt of recordation; and

subsections.label: (e)
subsections.plainText: (e) no permanent certificate of occupancy shall be issued for the building either altered or developed, as set forth in Section 37-40, or enlarged, that is subject to the subway stair relocation requirement or is counting a renovated subway stair as pedestrian circulation space in accordance with the provisions of Section 37-50, inclusive, unless and until all of the work required under paragraph (a) or (b) of this Section has been completed and New York City Transit has so certified in writing to the Department of Buildings.
